codeReview.summary: The commit delivers a full-viewport hero, CTA-based smooth scroll, and dark-theme styling, but it misses a core implementation constraint for hero image sourcing and introduces a layout overlap regression.

issues.description: Hero image is hardcoded to an external Unsplash URL instead of using a bundled static asset or first available trip photo as specified. This also makes load-time/availability dependent on a third-party network request, undermining the 3-second load expectation.
Header was changed to fixed positioning (lines 26-31), but main content has no top offset/padding. On non-home routes the top portion of content can render under the header, causing visual overlap.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `fullstack-worker` procedure requires TDD and running Vitest (`npx vitest run --reporter=verbose`), but this session only ran `npm run typecheck && npm run lint`; no tests were added or executed despite `skillFeedback.followedProcedure: true`.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Skill file: .factory/skills/fullstack-worker/SKILL.md (Steps 3, 5, 6). Transcript skeleton for session bea7d6e4-8c72-4594-9f64-a840b4c5ab20 shows only `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` and no vitest command. Handoff marks followedProcedure=true.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared architecture docs state a `public/` static-assets directory in project structure, but worker hit a missing-directory error when trying to use it. This mismatch can mislead future workers implementing bundled assets.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md lists `public/` in the tree. Transcript skeleton includes `LS /Users/primmer/trip_tracker/public` -> `Directory does not exist`.

summary: Review failed due to a blocking requirement miss: the hero image source is external instead of bundled/derived from trip data. Also noted a non-blocking fixed-header overlap regression and two shared-state documentation/process gaps.
